metadata.name: fork_contracts
metadata.description: Escrowed binary conditional LMSR prediction market

instructions.name: create_market_for_budget
docs: Size depth from a funding budget before anyone contributes. Both depth
and starting probability remain immutable, including throughout Funding.

instructions.name: migrate_market
docs: Permissionless, idempotent rent top-up. Existing economics never change.

accounts.name: market
docs: market PDA checked in the handler before any resize or write.

instructions.name: set_fee
docs: Only changes the default for future markets. Existing LP/trader terms are immutable.

errors.name: Math
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow or unsupported numeric range

errors.name: NotTrading
errors.msg: Trading is paused, closed, frozen or not started

errors.name: Insolvent
errors.msg: Reserves do not cover all outcomes

errors.name: Locked
errors.msg: Withdrawal is locked until terminal settlement

fields.name: fees_accrued
docs: Conditional fees: embedded in LP residual on valid settlement; canceled on VOID.
